creator_content_formats.label: Official song / music video
creator_content_formats.rights: Artist or label recording and composition, with eligible rights administration; ownership not implied by chart rank

creator_content_formats.label: Lyric and user-generated music video
creator_content_formats.rights: Song, sound recording, visuals and uploaders can have distinct rights holders
creator_content_formats.measure: song-attributed views, not a second unique listener count

creator_content_formats.label: Shorts made with music
creator_content_formats.rights: Rights and eligibility depend on the platform's music use and claims policy
creator_content_formats.measure: Shorts using recording, not listener population

creator_content_formats.label: Original independent musician uploads
creator_content_formats.rights: Recording and composition may be original yet use separately licensed materials
creator_content_formats.measure: artist uploads and view events; no representative income

creator_content_formats.label: Covers, reviews and reaction clips
creator_content_formats.rights: Performance, composition, synchronization and reused recording permissions differ
creator_content_formats.measure: video events cannot establish who gets advertising proceeds

creator_content_formats.label: Live performance and music tutorials
creator_content_formats.rights: Live and archived content may involve composition and recording rights
creator_content_formats.measure: stream watch hours not equivalent to music video chart rank

restrictions: Publisher music-video viewing share is not total music listening or distinct people.
Top Songs on Shorts count creations, not views; they cannot be added to song video-view rankings.
Music Insights omits Shorts, and its song attribution may span numerous uploaders.
Content ID owner rules and claimant geography can alter availability and advertising payout independently of video popularity.
Selected chart rankings are not a random sample of emerging or nonmonetized independent music creators.
